description: Sends feedback to Forkmate to improve the app: a bug, a feature request, a food or nutrition figure that looked wrong (food_data), or something else. It is for feedback the user has asked to send, in the user's own words rather than a paraphrase. It changes nothing in the diary. The note is kept in the user's own account and deleted with it, and no reply is sent.

about.description: What the note is about: logging (saving or editing meals), accuracy (a food or number that looked wrong), connect (connecting this AI app), or other.

category.description: The kind of feedback: bug (something broken), feature_request (something the user would like), food_data (a wrong food match or nutrition figure), or other.

message.description: The feedback, in the user's own words as they said it (at most 4000 characters).

rating.description: The user's thumbs up or down on Forkmate, when they gave one.

name: send_feedback
